title: Idempotency Is Not Recovery: A Fault-Injection Study of Language-Model Agent Tool Actions
abstract: arXiv:2611.23353v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When a language-model agent's tool call is interrupted, the action may already have changed an external system without confirmation. Retrying risks duplication; assuming success may conceal an action that never occurred. We study these failure modes in a controlled agent runtime combining authorization, an action ledger, target-side idempotency, reconciliation, and evidence sealing. We inject ten single-host fault classes and compare four configurations and three ablations using a target-side oracle separate from the runtime ledger. On each of Windows and Linux, 7,513 trials used 96 captured model responses from 24 constructed cases. In 200 known original crash and replay pairs, the full configuration recorded 0/200 repeated effects versus 117/200 for each simpler baseline. translated_title: 幂等性不等于恢复：语言模型代理工具操作的故障注入研究
translated_abstract: 当语言模型代理的工具调用被中断时，该操作可能已经在未经确认的情况下改变了外部系统。重试存在重复执行的风险；而假定成功则可能掩盖一个从未真正发生的操作。我们在一个受控的代理运行时环境中研究这些故障模式，该环境结合了授权机制、操作账本、目标端幂等性、对账机制和证据封存。我们注入了十类单主机故障，并使用独立于运行时账本的目标端预言机，比较了四种配置和三种消融设置。在Windows和Linux两种系统上各进行了7,513次试验，使用了从24个构建案例中捕获的96个模型响应。在200组已知的原始崩溃与重放对中，完整配置记录了0/200的重复副作用，而各个较简单的基线则达到117/200。与账本相关的消融实验产生了170/170的孤立副作用（完整配置为0/170），恢复成功率仅为200/300（完整配置为300/300）。禁用对账机制……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过系统的故障注入实验揭示“幂等性不等于恢复”，证明只有将授权、操作账本、目标端幂等性、对账与证据封存相结合的完整配置，才能将语言模型代理工具调用的重复副作用从基线的117/200降至0/200，并保障故障后的恢复能力。
en_tdlr: Through systematic fault-injection experiments, this paper demonstrates that "idempotency is not recovery"—only a full configuration combining authorization, an action ledger, target-side idempotency, reconciliation, and evidence sealing eliminates repeated side effects of LLM agent tool calls (0/200 vs. 117/200 for simpler baselines) and ensures recovery.
